scope: Arithmetic consistency of disclosed seller inputs, model outputs, cost budgets, currency conversion and totals. This is not independent validation of assumed effort, market value, product performance, ownership or transfer readiness. displayCurrency.rounding: Each EUR amount is converted at ECB 6 November 2026 EUR/USD 1.1165, half-up to a whole USD. EUR seller asks retain their 3 November 2026 dated basis; USD is illustrative only. Portfolio conversion rounds the aggregate, not the sum of rounded individual USD figures.
